response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages), above_first AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT af.avg_pulse_rate, af.excess_first, af.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second FROM above_first AS af CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE af.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM above_second
